## What's Changed

- Added export support for Markdown, HTML, and PDF.
  - Exported files are written next to the current Markdown file.
  - PDF export uses the local Chrome, Chromium, or Microsoft Edge through `puppeteer-core`.
  - Local images are inlined for exported HTML/PDF output.
- Improved ABC music score export.
  - ABC code blocks are rendered to music-score SVGs before PDF printing.
  - Exported scores are centered and avoid being split across pages.
- Added persistent code block preview theme settings.
  - `mutsumiMarkdown.codeBlockTheme` controls the Vditor code highlight theme.
  - Choosing a theme from Vditor's code block theme menu now saves it to the current workspace.
  - Exported HTML and PDF use the same code block theme.

## Notes

- PDF export requires Chrome, Chromium, or Microsoft Edge. If it cannot be found automatically, set `mutsumiMarkdown.chromiumPath`.
- Reload VS Code or restart the Extension Development Host after installing this version so new commands and settings are picked up.
